name: RFP Draft Section
description: Writes one narrative section of the proposal from drafted responses and approved company content, within a word budget (ADR-0016).

inputs.sample: One page; restate the buyer's top three objectives and map each to the solution.
Example Water Authority seeks a single work and asset management platform.
Halcyon Ridge Systems was founded in 2009.

example.text:
Example Water Authority wants one platform for work and asset management.

Halcyon Ridge Systems has delivered that platform since 2009.
